top_band: snow-covered roof slope in white and light blue-grey tones from row 8 to row 35
evidence: The main body is a cabin with a large pitched roof seen from above (rows 8-35, 28 rows tall) and a vertical log wall front face below it (rows 36-58, 23 rows tall). The roof has a shaded front snow lip (rows 31-35), a dark eave shadow with icicles at rows 36-38, and inset windows and door on the front wall.

style.evidence: The cabin uses 5+ shading steps on both the snow roof (white to slate blue-grey with textured snowdrifts and exposed shingles) and the log walls/woodwork (multiple browns with wood grain, glowing multi-step window panes, snow piles, and icicles). Outlines are dark material tones and tile detail density matches the Beodeul house references.
